title: AgentGUI: An Interface for Observing and Steering Long-Running AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2607.26300v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI agents are increasingly adept at tackling complex, long-running tasks. With the rapid surge of autonomous capabilities, human oversight is systematically lagging behind due to limited human-centered interfacing. Aiming to address this, we introduce AgentGUI, a user-friendly, locally hosted GUI for seamlessly observing and steering AI agents amid multiple concurrent, long-running sessions. AgentGUI features 1) rich agent trajectory visualizations, 2) effective manual and automated steering, and 3) integration with and coordination between open-source and frontier agent frameworks. A controlled user study demonstrates statistically significant reduction in the time it takes to identify key elements from agent traces (38% faster, p = 0.023). In a preliminary experiment, AgentGUI's automated drift prevention feature raises the task completion rate of small local agents by as high as 34pp across a 0.8B--9B model ladder (N=50 runs

translated_title: AgentGUI：用于观察和引导长时运行AI代理的界面
translated_abstract: AI代理在处理复杂、长时间运行的任务方面日益熟练。随着自主能力的快速增长，由于缺乏以人为中心的交互界面，人类监督正系统性地滞后。为解决这一问题，我们提出了AgentGUI，一个用户友好、本地托管的图形界面，用于在多个并发的长时间运行会话中无缝观察和引导AI代理。AgentGUI具有以下特点：1）丰富的代理轨迹可视化，2）有效的手动和自动引导功能，3）与开源及前沿代理框架的集成与协调。一项受控用户研究表明，从代理轨迹中识别关键要素的时间有统计学显著性的减少（快38%，p = 0.023）。在一项初步实验中，AgentGUI的自动防偏航功能在0.8B至9B的模型规模梯度上（N=50次运行）将小型本地代理的任务完成率提高了高达34个百分点。
tldr: AgentGUI是一个本地托管的图形界面，通过丰富的轨迹可视化、手动与自动引导以及多框架集成协调，显著提升了人类对长时运行AI代理的监督效率（轨迹分析提速38%）和小型本地代理的任务完成率（最高提升34个百分点）。
en_tdlr: AgentGUI is a user-friendly, locally hosted GUI that enables seamless observation and steering of multiple concurrent long-running AI agents through rich trajectory visualization, manual/automated steering, and framework integration, achieving 38% faster trace analysis and up to 34pp task completion rate improvement for small local agents.
